snippet.title: Gemini Argon 4 VS Opus 5.5 (No Hype)
snippet.description:
✅Higgsfield: https://higgsfield.ai/s/katana-inside-claude-yt-jadm-h-xUOkwW

Gemini 4 Argon is officially out, and X is calling it the Opus killer. So I skipped Google's own charts, went straight to the independent benchmarks, and gave Argon and Claude Opus 5.5 the exact same app prompt to see which one builds the better app 👇

🐦 What people on X are saying
• The hype: someone who says they work at Google DeepMind: "I don't reach for Opus anymore"
• The other side: "Opus 5.5 is still the best model in the world"
• The skeptic: Google's launch charts for Gemini 3.1 Pro also "destroyed" Claude

🛠️ What people are building with it
• Alan Wake 2 converted to run natively on a Mac (Max Weinbach)
• A 3D museum of Apple computers, built without a single image given (Justine Moore)

⚔️ Side-by-side tests (read the label, not just the caption)
• Argon vs "Opus 5.5 Medium": Opus wasn't on its top setting
• "Argon: 3 min, 50 cents" comes from a company that sells access to Argon
• Another test found the opposite: Argon cost $5.29 vs about $1.50 for Opus
• Devin says Argon is the best Gemini on their leaderboard, but Opus 5.5 is above it on their own chart

📊 Independent benchmarks (Oct 13, 2026)
• Arena, blind human votes, text: Argon #1, Opus 5.5 #2
• WebDev Arena: Opus 5.5 #1, Argon #9
• Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: Opus 5.5 58, Argon 53
• Hallucination rate (AA-Omniscience): Argon 15%, Opus 5.5 59%
• Vals Index: Argon #1 · Vals Terminal-Bench 4.0: Opus 5.5 #1, Argon #6

🧪 My test: Argon vs Opus 5.5
Same prompt, word for word: a phone app for a painting and flooring contractor. Scan the room, build it in 3D, change the paint and floor live, and price it into a quote the customer signs with their finger. One HTML file, no server. The sample room has exactly 1 correct price: $3,104.68.
✅ Both got the price right: $3,104.68
✅ Both built a working 3D room that updates the paint and floor live
💭 In my opinion, Opus 5.5 built the better app (its 3D room is more detailed). Judge for yourself.
To be fair: Opus 5.5 built its app in Claude Code, where it can run and check its own code. Argon built its app in a single API reply (high reasoning, about 7 minutes, $0.58). The camera scan wasn't tested on a real phone here.

💵 Price and who can use it
$2 per million input tokens, $10 output, until November 30, 2026. After that, $4 / $20, the same as Opus 5.5.
Google AI Pro and Ultra (Gemini app, AI Mode in Search), Ultra in Antigravity, and the paid Gemini API. Not on the free plan yet.

💭 My take
Argon is the real deal. For research, writing, legal or finance, I'd 100% try it, especially at half price. For coding and building skills, my choice comes down to tests like this one.
